source.interpretation: RANDOM initiation with fixed IQTY=3 and IDISP=RANDOM draws three independent uniform start times in one IPER=12 period per replication. IQTYD remains empty; MPAT remains the parent's fixed mission pattern.

exact_delta: Control.NREPS changes 1 to 32; seed, simulation end and report interval remain fixed.
SystemDeployment.QTYPS changes 1 to 3 and Unit.DESCR changes only a label, so all three missions can start even if their random times cluster.
Three A02 scheduled OperationProfile rows at 8, 20 and 32 become one RANDOM row at STIM=8, IQTY=3, IQTYD empty, IPER=12, IDISP=RANDOM; DTIM remains the parent's one-third hour.

ProblemDescription.PDESC changes only a label; MissionType remains the accepted two-hour fixed template with 0.25 outbound/return fractions and zero failure rate. All 26 other tables remain identical.
predeclared_native_acceptance: One immutable guarded session-0 SSH run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID 13340 identity guard, source/raw SHA-256 seals, four CLI steps and exact row-containing source roundtrip; zero conversion errors and classified warnings.

If the native event log includes every replication, require exactly 32 replication groups and three distinct fixed-template mission starts per group, all in [8,20), each with its own success/completion two hours later; no cancellation, failure or stock demand. If the native event log omits groups, classify the per-replication timing claim unverified and do not publish it from aggregate reports alone.
Require at least two distinct realized start-time triples across replications. Retain the exact 96 native start times rather than treating seed 1 as a portable random stream.

Calculate sample mean, sample variance and a 95 percent Student-t confidence half-width for the 96 start times, targeting at most one hour half-width. Report the observed estimate and precision without claiming that one fixed-seed sample proves a uniform law or independent streams.

Reconcile 72 aligned half-hour system and stock bins as averages over 32 replications; expected completed mission operation is six aircraft-hours per replication and three aircraft ready at the end. Do not multiply averaged rows into per-replication event claims.
A separate read-only reviewer replays source delta, raw seals, event groups, statistics and aggregate ledgers without importing author validation.
limits: One fixed quantity of three, one period, one seed and 32 native replications. Random mission quantity, equidistant layout, zero period and invalid combinations require separate variants.

A finite sample and a confidence interval estimate precision of its mean; they do not prove the native generator's distribution or independence. GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
